scientific_integrity: The infinite claim is proved symbolically; finite checks supplement the proof only.
scientific_limitations: The exact Abelian complexity is proved on lengths equal to powers of three; only a sharp logarithmic envelope is claimed for all lengths. Possible unindexed identical prior calculations and an inaccessible 2016 full text remain priority risks. No independent validation.
title: Sharp Abelian-complexity envelope for ternary digit-two parity
